shortDescription: Reusable action card for membership entry points.
fullDescription: Displays a large clickable membership action with a circular icon, emphasized title, and optional muted surface styling. It is designed for dashboard-style launch sections where views need consistent action tiles for creating memberships, resuming pending work, or similar flows.

Renders a branded member verification capture screen with a top navigation bar, a camera selector, a centered photo preview stage, a right-side instruction panel, and footer actions for returning home, canceling, taking a photo, and confirming a saved image. The view reuses the shared button, select, and separator components to keep the image capture workflow visually consistent with the rest of the application.
